chip.description: Sprite list processor and graphics-ROM address generator of the 051960/051937 pair, also generating IRQ, FIRQ and NMI for the main CPU; addresses 1 MB of sprite ROM directly (taxonomy §4.19 example).
chip.notes: src/mame/konami/k051960.cpp in MAME 0.288: "The 051960 manages the sprite list and produces an address that is fed to the gfx ROMs ... can also generate IRQ, FIRQ and NMI signals."
